targetTexts.1: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
targetTexts.2: God also told Moses, “I am the LORD.
targetTexts.3: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
targetTexts.4: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
targetTexts.5: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
targetTexts.6: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
targetTexts.7: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
targetTexts.8: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’”
targetTexts.9: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
targetTexts.10: So the LORD said to Moses,
targetTexts.11: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
targetTexts.12: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech?”
targetTexts.13: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
targetTexts.14: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
targetTexts.15: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
targetTexts.16: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
targetTexts.17: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
targetTexts.18: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
targetTexts.19: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
targetTexts.20: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
targetTexts.21: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
targetTexts.22: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
targetTexts.23: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
targetTexts.24: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
targetTexts.25: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans.
targetTexts.26: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.”
targetTexts.27: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
targetTexts.28: Now on the day that the LORD spoke to Moses in Egypt,
targetTexts.29: He said to him, “I am the LORD; tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I say to you.”
targetTexts.30: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “Since I am unskilled in speech, why would Pharaoh listen to me?”
